articles.title: The 9/11 firefighter whose death went uncounted
articles.content: He'd only been home from work for five hours, anyway. "A plane just hit the World Trade Center!" a voice bellowed. "Dad, they're going to need everybody," 27-year-old Keith said. "You better get down here."
